chunks.text: **Snapshot:** 24 October 2026 · THB · Thailand domestic marketplace · Standard (Non-Mall) and Mall/Official sellers

chunks.title: Executive finding
chunks.text: Shopee’s current public fee policy is Help Center article 77254, revised **3 July 2026**, with the sale-fee schedule explicitly changed effective **4 August 2026, 00:00 Thailand time**. It defines payment, platform infrastructure, account-maintenance, sale, installment and Special SPayLater charges, including bases and VAT treatment. It links category schedules as Google Drive files; the schedule rows were not independently normalized here. Therefore exact category-specific sale rates are **UNVERIFIED** and must be looked up in the linked sheet/PDF or seller settlement—not invented. Official page: https://help.shopee.co.th/portal/4/article/77254

chunks.title: Five-line executive summary
chunks.text:
1. **All-in fee range:** no defensible single range; category sale rates, campaign/service enrollment, shipping and return adjustments are seller/order-specific or unavailable.
2. **Known standard-order charges:** 3% transaction fee + 7% VAT on the stated payment base, and ฿1 infrastructure fee + VAT per eligible successful order; not a complete take-rate.
3. **Commission:** category/tier formula is `(starting item price − seller-funded discount) × rate`; schedule effective 4 Aug 2026, but exact category rows remain unnormalized. Eligible small shops at ≤฿10,000 prior-30-day sales may get a 0.5–1.5% sale-fee discount; exact eligibility/tier is unresolved.
4. **Typical illustration:** ฿1,000 item + ฿40 buyer shipping gives ฿34.454 raw payment/PIF subtotal; illustrative whole-baht rounding yields ฿34, before sale fee, seller shipping, campaigns, ads or affiliate.
5. **Production rule:** use seller-specific fee schedule, program terms and escrow/settlement statement; Mall fee VAT wording remains conflicting and unresolved.

chunks.title: Evidence and status convention
chunks.text: **Official** = directly stated in current Shopee policy/official seller or developer documentation; **official but inaccessible/unverified** = official link/search record exists but contents unavailable or page is gated; **secondary** = non-Shopee source (not used for rates); **inferred** = arithmetic or interpretation clearly identified; **unverified** = no authoritative numeric term found. Publication/revision date is distinguished from effective date. Where policy leaves rounding, settlement is authoritative.

chunks.title: Category coverage (the requested 11 buckets)
chunks.text:
1. Commission/referral: sale transaction fees above (Mall and Non-Mall schedules) and AMS affiliate (optional, terms-specific).
2. Transaction/payment: payment transaction, installment card, Special SPayLater.
3. Services/programs: PIF, account maintenance, PRIME/free-shipping programs, Seller Coins and optional services; no universal public program charge beyond PIF.
4. Campaign fees/requirements: event-specific and Seller Centre gated; no universal fee found.
5. Vouchers/discount funding/base: seller-funded item discount lowers sale-fee base; Shopee-funded PRM/Coins enter payment-fee base; shipping/other discounts excluded from sale-fee base. Voucher funding attribution and per-campaign co-funding proportions must be obtained from order settlement.
6. Shipping, returns, COD, fulfillment: separate, service/parcel-dependent; no single current rate card validated.
7. Affiliate: AMS seller-paid commission versus Seller Affiliate/Social Partners seller-received compensation are distinct.
8. Advertising: optional, spend/budget based; no order take-rate established.
9. Refund/return/cancel/penalties: policy potentially waives specified fees; acceptance/time window and ledger reversal are essential. Penalties not quantified.
10. VAT/WHT: clear VAT split in current fee policy except Mall conflict; WHT seller-specific/unverified.
11. Listing/subscription/withdrawal/account: only inactive-account ฿20/mo verified; other universal fees not found.

chunks.title: Formula specification (auditable; do not blend unlike bases)
chunks.text: For each order, retain raw order/escrow and statement lines; determine category, seller tier, payment method, promotion funding, fulfillment, status and enrollment first.

chunks.title: Formula specification (auditable; do not blend unlike bases)
chunks.text:
- `sale_base = max(0, starting_item_price - seller_funded_item_discount)` (per policy; per-SKU allocation required for multi-item orders).
- `sale_fee = apply_current_account_discount(category_rate[tier, category, effective_date], eligible_smallshop_discount, sale_base)`. The policy describes a 0.5–1.5% small-shop sale-fee discount for shops at or below ฿10,000 in preceding 30-day sales, but the exact tier/eligibility application is not normalized here; obtain actual Seller Center rate before calculating.
- `payment_base = buyer_item_amount_payable_ex_shipping + buyer_paid_shipping + Shopee_Item_PRM + Shopee_Coins`. This separates goods amount from shipping so shipping is counted exactly once. In the examples, “Buyer payable” means checkout total including shipping; the payment base starts from goods payable, adds shipping, then adds Shopee PRM/Coins. Exclude seller-funded discount only once (it is already reflected in buyer goods payable); do not subtract it a second time. Reconcile the exact meaning of each API amount to order fields.
- `payment_fee_exVAT = 0.03 * payment_base`; `VAT = 0.07 * payment_fee_exVAT`; payment fee billed = sum.
- Installment card/SPayLater: substitute payment-method-specific rate and corresponding paid amount/shipping base; do **not** stack standard 3% separately because the policy describes those rates as inclusive of the base transaction component.
- `PIF_exVAT = 1 THB` per successful order; `PIF_VAT=0.07` when taxable.
- `account_maintenance = 20 THB/month` for qualifying inactive account, VAT inclusive; balance capture can be partial per policy.
- Net settlement is not fully determinable from these public inputs: `buyer/platform funding receipts + seller proceeds − fee ledger − shipping/fulfillment − optional programs/ads/affiliate − tax/adjustment lines`. Reconcile to actual escrow and adjustments, not this simplified equation.

chunks.title: Formula specification (auditable; do not blend unlike bases)
chunks.text: **Rounding:** Shopee Terms of Service §20.3 states fees including VAT with a fractional satang of **50 satang or more** round up to a whole baht; below 50 satang round down. The term does not explicitly say whether multiple fee types are rounded separately or in aggregate, so examples show raw arithmetic and illustrative per-fee whole-baht posting; match the exact fee lines in settlement. Source: https://help.shopee.co.th/portal/4/article/77241.

chunks.title: Conflicts and unresolved items
chunks.text:
1. **Mall sale-fee VAT:** Help Center 77254 says fees (3)-(5), including Mall sale fee, include VAT 7%. Seller Education Hub article 2219 (dated 20 Aug 2026) states that Mall sale and promotional-service rates exclude VAT. These are conflicting official sources; the Hub article is newer and Mall-specific, so provisionally prefer it for Mall schedule interpretation, but block production VAT treatment until current Seller Center schedule/invoice or written Shopee clarification resolves the conflict.
2. **Category-specific rates:** links exposed from 77254 to Thai/English files for both tiers and before/after schedule; numeric rows were not verified/normalized. Rate per category is blocked.
3. **Current campaign calendars, campaign fees, PRIME service rates, free-shipping co-funding, COD, FBS fees, withdrawal charges, exact return-shipping charges:** no complete public numeric source verified. Seller Centre/contract/settlement evidence required.
4. **WHT:** seller profile, fee type and tax documents matter; no one-size-fits-all seller WHT rate/base established.
5. **Order-field arithmetic:** policy says buyer-payable plus shipping + platform PRM + Coins, but exact API field definitions for voucher funding and payment base need verification against escrow response and statement. Avoid duplicate additions.

chunks.title: Lazada Thailand seller-fee specification
chunks.text: **Snapshot:** 24 October 2026 · **Currency:** THB · **Scope:** domestic Thailand Marketplace (general seller) and LazMall. This is a research specification, not a binding seller tariff. Seller Center login-only fee schedules, enrollment terms, and settlement statements prevail. “Official” below means Lazada/its Open Platform; “secondary” means independent or third-party reporting. Where the public official page did not expose the fee table body, that limitation is explicit rather than treating a search snippet as a fully inspected schedule.

chunks.title: Executive findings and source quality
chunks.text: The dependable public picture is: a completed-order Marketplace Service Fee (MSF/commission), a payment/transaction fee, and optional/program-dependent fees. Public sources disagree on VAT presentation, program bundling and some rates. The current official LazMall join page displays headline commission of **17.5%** and payment fee of **3.21%** (VAT-inclusive wording), while also presenting a 6–13% category table; no effective date or clear reconciliation was exposed. The official Seller Center has fee-table/program notices updated **6 May 2026** and a fee/Premium Package change notice dated **25 June 2026**, but accessible page bodies did not reveal a complete current leaf-category schedule. Therefore exact Marketplace and LazMall rates remain seller/category-specific and unverified from a complete official tariff.

chunks.title: Formula specification (use as provisional until matched to settlement)
chunks.text: Let `P` = listed item price, `SD` = seller-funded item discount, `PD` = platform-funded discount, `S_b` = buyer-paid shipping, `r_msf` = applicable category/tier MSF rate. The official LazMall page displays `r_pay = 0.0321` on item price, but the general-seller rate and authoritative fee base are unresolved.

chunks.title: Formula specification (use as provisional until matched to settlement)
chunks.text:
- Provisional commission basis: `B_msf = P − SD` (platform discount treatment not verified); `MSF = B_msf × r_msf`.
- Official Mall payment-fee case, if applicable: use the current Seller Center base as given (public join page displays 3.21% × item price, but reconcile with settlement); do not infer shipping or voucher treatment from a secondary article.
- Provisional payment basis reported by secondary guides: `B_pay = (P − SD) + S_b`; `PaymentFee = B_pay × 0.0321`. This is not adopted as official; do not use until the seller’s current policy confirms it.
- Provisional Premium Package basis: `B_prog = P − SD`; `ProgramFee = B_prog × r_prog`, where reported 1 Aug 2026 `r_prog = 0.0856` VAT-inclusive. Confirm inclusion/eligibility before charging this in a model.
- If rate quoted pre-VAT: `fee incl. VAT = base × rate × 1.07`; if inclusive already, **do not multiply again**.
- Expected settlement before COGS, seller-paid freight, ads, affiliate, returns and taxes: buyer product/shipping payment + any reimbursed platform subsidy − seller discount − MSF − payment fee − enrolled program fees − logistics/adjustment lines. Settlement statement is authoritative; do not reconstruct from product price alone.
- No official Thai rounding rule found; preserve full precision until matched to the seller’s Finance statement and tax invoice.

chunks.title: Worked examples (illustrative, not a promised payout)
chunks.text:
1. **Marketplace, general merchandise example:** item price ฿1,000; seller discount ฿100; buyer-paid shipping ฿40; assumed applicable MSF **16.05%** (reported VAT-inclusive selected general categories); no optional program. Net item base ฿900. MSF = 900 × 16.05% = **฿144.45**. Payment fee = (900 + 40) × 3.21% = **฿30.17**. Fees total **฿174.62**; remainder from item and buyer shipping receipts = 940 − 174.62 = **฿765.38**, before seller-paid shipping, COGS, ads, affiliate, returns/tax adjustments. Rate/category must be checked against actual leaf SKU.
2. **Marketplace, fashion example:** item price ฿1,200; seller discount ฿0; buyer shipping ฿0; illustrative MSF **17.12% (secondary-only example; conflicts with the current official LazMall headline 17.5%)**. MSF = **฿205.44**; payment fee = **฿38.52**; total **฿243.96**; remainder **฿956.04** before other costs. This demonstrates why a Marketplace-wide flat commission is unsafe.
3. **LazMall + reported Premium Package example:** item ฿2,000; seller discount ฿0; buyer shipping ฿60; illustrative MSF **18.73%**, program **8.56%**. MSF **฿374.60**; payment fee `(2,000+60)×3.21%` = **฿66.13**; program fee **฿171.20**; total **฿611.93**; remainder from ฿2,060 receipts **฿1,448.07**. The 18.73% rate may not fit every Mall category; package enrollment/bundling and base must be checked in Seller Center.

chunks.title: Worked examples (illustrative, not a promised payout)
chunks.text: **Return/cancel example:** two items at ฿250 each; one is returned and the other retained. Provisional rule from secondary sources: reverse the fee on the returned item and retain fees on the kept ฿250 item only; assuming a 16.05% MSF and no shipping, retained-item MSF = ฿40.125 and payment fee = ฿8.025, total ฿48.15 (rounded once to two decimals; independently rounded line items sum to ฿48.16). If both items/order are fully cancelled/returned, secondary sources say both fees reverse (฿0 net fee), but official reversal timing, shipping charges and refund adjustment are **not verified**. Match the actual adjustment lines rather than applying this as a guaranteed rule.

chunks.title: Formula model and worked cases
chunks.text: For one item, before seller shipping, ads and affiliate unless stated:

chunks.title: Formula model and worked cases
chunks.text:
```text
sale_base = item_price - seller_funded_discount
commission = sale_base * shop_category_rate                 # category rate required
commerce_growth = min(sale_base * eligible_growth_rate, 199)
transaction_fee = (customer_payment + platform_discount) * 0.0321
infrastructure_fee = 1.07 if delivered and eligible
other = seller_program + seller_campaign + seller_affiliate + ads + shipping/adjustments
net_before_COGS = seller receipts + platform reimbursements - deductions - seller-funded discount
```

chunks.text: Rates below are shown tax-inclusive where so stated. Since official current commission table rows were not normalized, the **7.00% commission rate in these illustrations is hypothetical** and is not asserted to be a current category rate. The 2% PayLater program rate is an official example only.

chunks.title: Formula model and worked cases
chunks.text:
1. **Normal delivered item:** listed ฿1,000; no seller discount; no platform voucher; customer payment ฿1,000; hypothetical category commission 7.00%; non-electronics Commerce Growth 8.03%. Commission ฿70.00 + growth ฿80.30 + transaction `(1,000 + 0) × 3.21% = ฿32.10` + infrastructure ฿1.07 = **฿183.47**, excluding shipping, ads, affiliate and any seller program. Arithmetic independently checked.
2. **Seller discount + platform voucher:** listed ฿1,000; seller discount ฿100; platform voucher ฿100; customer pays ฿800. Commission base ฿900 at hypothetical 7.00% = ฿63.00; growth base ฿900 at 8.03% = ฿72.27; transaction base `(800+100)` = ฿900, fee ฿28.89; infrastructure ฿1.07. **Total ฿165.23**, before other costs. Platform discount excluded from commission/growth base but included in transaction base.
3. **Campaign/program opt-in:** same inputs as case 2 plus seller enrollment in BCD/Flash at 3.21% on the seller-discounted item base: `900 × 3.21% = ฿28.89`; plus PayLater program at illustrative 2% and no refund: `฿800 × 2% × 1.07 = ฿17.12`. Total `165.23 + 28.89 + 17.12` = **฿211.24**. The 2% PayLater rate is an official example, not a universal plan rate; BCD/Flash eligibility, return policy and campaign terms must apply. BCD and Flash cannot stack on the same product.
4. **Return after delivery:** if case 2 is delivered then fully returned, transaction ฿28.89, growth ฿72.27 and infrastructure ฿1.07 remain under the cited rules; commission treatment follows tier/order return policy (Mall policy refunds commission on returned items; verify Non-Mall settlement); seller-fault return shipping may be added. The actual reversal ledger is authoritative.

chunks.title: Fee formulas and worked cases
chunks.text:
1. **Ordinary eligible order:** assume ฿1,000 verified base for each fee, completed and marked shipped, LINE SHOPPING-attributed. Payment fee = 30.00; service fee = 30.00; VAT = 4.20; total = **฿64.20**. This is conditional, not a universal take-rate: many orders have only one fee or neither.
2. **Seller + platform coupons / published policy illustration:** item ฿500; seller item coupon ฿50; LINE SHOPPING coupon ฿50; shipping ฿40; seller shipping discount ฿10; LINE POINTS ฿200; buyer payment ฿230. Thai policy formula: transaction base `230+200=430` → fee ฿12.90; service base `230+50+200=480` → fee ฿14.40; VAT ฿1.91; total fee **฿29.21**. The English translation instead prints `(290+200) × 3%` for both formulas, inconsistent with the fee amounts; use Thai policy formula and validate against settlement.
3. **Eligible new-seller campaign:** assume qualifying seller within first 100 orders, below ฿100,000 GMV cap and within 30-day benefit; both normal bases assumed ฿1,000, with attribution. Transaction fee 0; service fee 30; VAT 2.10; total **฿32.10**. Campaign waives only transaction fee; seller must still satisfy all criteria.
4. **Return/cancellation after shipping:** if a fee was posted and the order is later returned, public policy does not specify reversal timing or partial refund arithmetic. Set expected reversal as `UNVERIFIED`; keep original debit and actual credit/debit adjustment separate. A pre-shipment cancellation that never meets completed/Mark-as-Shipped trigger is not a qualifying fee order under the policy wording.
